card: Adds Testnet 5 (BIP 95) to Bitcoin Core and the kernel library, establishing a new test network that removes the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, raises the minimum difficulty, and enforces BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from block 1. This prevents the block storms and difficulty manipulation that plagued Testnet 3 and Testnet 4 while providing an active network testing BIP 54. The PR depends directly on prerequisite PR #35793 (BIP 54), with only the top five commits introducing Testnet 5. The genesis block is not yet mined and seed infrastructure is pending.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto a 32.x maintenance branch with the Backport label added, introducing maintenance branch changes into the base diff while the five Testnet 5 commits remain unchanged.
evidence: PR description: 'Relative to Testnet 4 it removes the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception, raises the minimum difficulty, and enforces BIP 54 from block 1.'
Commit ef12208cc0: 'Testnet 5 is specified in BIP95. It drops the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception of Testnet 3/4 and raises the minimum difficulty to nBits 0x1a0fffff.'
PR description notes IRC dev meeting consensus to settle the changes alongside BIP 54 and potentially backport Testnet 5 to a v32 point release once genesis is mined.
problem: Earlier testnets suffer from block storms and severe difficulty manipulation caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception, and no existing public test network enforces BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.

risk.why: Flaws in consensus cleanup validation rules or chain parameters could cause chain forks, invalid block acceptance, or node crashes.

scope_notes: Only the top five commits belong to this PR; the remaining 22 commits belong to base PR #35793. The diff also reflects a rebase onto a 32.x maintenance branch (bearing the Backport label and version bump diffs). Genesis block and DNS seeds have not yet been added.
summary: Adds Testnet 5 (BIP 95) parameters, chain types, and kernel/CLI/GUI support to Bitcoin Core. Testnet 5 drops the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule used in earlier testnets, raises the minimum difficulty to 0x1a0fffff, and activates BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) rules starting from block 1. The pull request is stacked on top of BIP 54 implementation PR #35793, with only the top five commits belonging to Testnet 5.
